title: A minimum delivery order
bodyMd: A bakery introduced a minimum order of 15 euros for home delivery. Its average delivered order value rose from 12 to 18 euros, but daily delivery orders fell from 100 to 60. The owner said that the rise in the average demonstrated higher delivery revenue. A supervisor pointed out that the average must be multiplied by the number of orders. Collection orders were recorded separately and are not included in these figures.
